description: Capability for the main window and the pinned-note popover. Both are named here because capabilities are per-window: a window left out cannot even hide itself, and the calls are denied at runtime rather than failing to compile. Note that `core:default` is not as broad as it sounds — its window half grants only the read-only calls (is-visible, inner-size, title and so on) plus internal-toggle-maximize. Anything that actually moves or hides a window has to be asked for by name, which is why allow-hide is listed separately below despite hide() looking like the most ordinary thing a window could do.
